title: MutationEnvelope
description: Single-mutation request envelope for game.act. One typed state-changing command per envelope; no batching in v1 (plan §5.1). The supervisor supplies acting match/timeline/civ/run/authority from the authenticated connection — never from these args.

actionId.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Same ID + same request returns the original receipt; same ID + different request is ACTION_ID_CONFLICT.

expectedRevision.description: State revision the client observed. Mismatch (for a fresh actionId) is STALE_STATE.

type.description: Typed command name, e.g. unit.move. Unknown types are rejected; never dispatched by reflection.

args.description: Typed arguments for the command. Schemas per command family are pinned in W4; v1 envelope carries them opaquely.
